scope: Read-only control-flow and source-preservation audit plus independent CPU-only unit execution; no GPU execution or result-quality review

checks.name: single_factor
checks.evidence: Only active self.response_budget changes from 4 to positive infinity. Symmetric gamma .5, tau1, U8/P4/W32/pool64, kappa1, eta1e-4 and residual attenuation off remain frozen.

checks.name: bootstrap_init_only
checks.evidence: online Controller/RefinedController/SpeedController/ExperimentalBEPC constructors only initialize state/install hooks; no original initialize_tree/tree_decoding/update calls. math.inf replaces bootstrap4 before any input forward or candidate decision.

checks.name: old_score_path
checks.evidence: Equal rescue/protection scales use SpeedController.allowed verbatim, unchanged native margins, shortcut bounds, full score and legal parent contexts.

checks.name: branch_and_round_rules
checks.evidence: Frozen budgeted_scan retained. finite committed+branch mismatch count cannot reach infinity; round budget2 and all padding/EOS/visible-boundary logic unchanged. First-longest tie rule and selected-path-only commit unchanged.

checks.name: observer_lifecycle
checks.evidence: ExperimentalBEPC.evaluate cap-exhausted fast path never enters; update retirement condition finite count >= infinity never true. Observer stays alive until normal restore.

checks.name: statistics_and_json
checks.evidence: final_stats overwrites inherited infinity with JSON null before caller serialization; explicit no-cap/retirement false fields. Committed counters remain integers. json.dumps allow_nan=False exercised at 12 mismatches.

checks.name: inherited_forward_and_stopping
checks.evidence: Inherited run_benchmark generation, original native Target/Draft, tree/KV/update, max_new_tokens/EOS and terminal-update implementation are byte-identical copied files; no new overrides.

checks.name: concurrent_controls
checks.evidence: run_uncapped factory selects uncapped subclass only by explicit config flag; capped/strict controls checked byte-for-byte against prior raw and returned tokens, input, acceptance lengths and paths.

checks.name: cpu_tests
checks.evidence: 6/6 tests passed in spec Python with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. Includes 10,000 independent randomized scan checks, 12 committed mismatches, no retirement, round2, off-path accounting, capped4 control and parameter guards.

checks.name: previous_preservation
checks.evidence: All 213 prior file SHA256 entries match; ten key inherited files are real byte-identical copies, not symlinks.

limitations: No GPU numerical/decoding claim established by this review; concurrent capped/strict historical parity must pass at runtime.
Frozen config/protocol/entry source seal must be finalized before generation; this core review does not approve an unseen configuration.
Removing the response cap can increase cumulative relaxed decisions and active BEPC feature overhead. Speed and quality are empirical and are not guaranteed.
No human factual-ground-truth conclusion; quality conclusions require official task evaluation and uncertainty reporting.
